taxonomy.name: Open AIRS purpose taxonomy
taxonomy.description: Neutral purpose tags used by extraction records to describe what a composition is for. Tags describe activity, never legal conclusions: rule packs map tags and other facts to legal categories.

tags.label: Document summarisation
tags.definition: Condense documents or conversations into shorter readable outputs.

tags.label: Content drafting
tags.definition: Draft or rewrite text such as messages, reports or documentation.

tags.label: Translation
tags.definition: Translate content between languages.

tags.label: Information retrieval
tags.definition: Search and return existing information from designated sources.

tags.label: Research synthesis
tags.definition: Combine multiple sources into briefs, comparisons or recommendations.

tags.label: Data analysis
tags.definition: Inspect, transform, aggregate or explain datasets and metrics.

tags.label: Software development
tags.definition: Generate, review or explain source code and technical configurations.

tags.label: Customer support
tags.definition: Answer or route requests from customers or external users.

tags.label: Internal productivity
tags.definition: Assist employees with everyday internal tasks without external effect.

tags.label: Meeting support
tags.definition: Prepare, brief, transcribe or follow up meetings.

tags.label: Marketing content
tags.definition: Produce promotional or brand content.

tags.label: Commercial prospecting
tags.definition: Identify, target or contact prospects for commercial purposes.

tags.label: Contract review
tags.definition: Analyse contracts or clauses for gaps, risks or compliance with a reference.

tags.label: Recruitment
tags.definition: Support hiring: advertise, source, analyse or manage applications.

tags.label: Candidate selection
tags.definition: Filter, rank, score or otherwise evaluate job applicants.

tags.label: Worker management
tags.definition: Allocate tasks, monitor or manage employees or contractors.

tags.label: Performance evaluation
tags.definition: Evaluate the performance or behaviour of identified workers.

tags.label: Education admission
tags.definition: Determine access or assignment to education or vocational training.

tags.label: Exam scoring
tags.definition: Evaluate learning outcomes or steer a person's learning path.

tags.label: Creditworthiness assessment
tags.definition: Evaluate the solvency or credit score of natural persons.

tags.label: Insurance risk pricing
tags.definition: Assess or price life or health insurance risk for natural persons.

tags.label: Essential services access
tags.definition: Decide or influence access to essential private or public services or benefits.

tags.label: Emergency dispatch
tags.definition: Classify or prioritise emergency calls and responses.

tags.label: Critical infrastructure safety
tags.definition: Act as a safety component of critical physical or digital infrastructure.

tags.label: Biometric identification
tags.definition: Identify natural persons from biometric data.

tags.label: Biometric categorisation
tags.definition: Categorise natural persons from biometric data.

tags.label: Emotion recognition
tags.definition: Infer emotions or intentions of natural persons.

tags.label: Law enforcement support
tags.definition: Support police or criminal-justice activities.

tags.label: Migration and border
tags.definition: Support migration, asylum or border-control activities.

tags.label: Justice and democratic processes
tags.definition: Support judicial decisions or influence elections and referenda.

tags.label: Social scoring
tags.definition: Evaluate or classify persons over time based on social behaviour or characteristics.

tags.label: Behaviour influence
tags.definition: Steer the behaviour of persons, including persuasion or manipulation techniques.

tags.label: Medical support
tags.definition: Support diagnosis, treatment or other healthcare activities.

tags.label: Physical world actuation
tags.definition: Control or influence machinery, vehicles or other physical processes.
